follow-up time: The study followed women up to delivery.
exposure: estimated fetal weight using Hadlock formula
outcome: accuracy of fetal weight estimation by clinical and ultrasound methods
correlation of estimated fetal weight with actual birth weight
cohort: The study included 500 pregnant women with singleton pregnancies who attended antenatal check-ups or were admitted to the obstetric ward.
finding: The study found that estimation of fetal weight at term by clinical method using symphysio-fundal height and abdominal girth is as accurate as ultrasound estimation using the Hadlock formula.
birth_weight: The average actual birth weight was 2758.19 +/- 341.25 grams.
